label: processreview
claim: Sciences' six-row confidence table is carried as qualification; numerical reproduction does not establish installed performance.
source_report_body:
Review complete; detail in REVIEW.md. Common accounts, weather arithmetic, growth and carbon screens bought useful conditional results; installed safety and availability remain unqualified.

The supplied ledger contains 147 distinct units: 72 cards, 71 checks, four registers. First-report timings mix retry requests, partials, owner clarifications and check-ins; CHECK050 also names the wrong seat. CHECK029/040 are labelled clean despite consequential findings. Pool quota divided by jobs is not measured marginal cost; 40% fewer jobs and halved coordination cost remain hypotheses.

I disagree with ranking checks as the largest waste. Early checks caught product-form errors, invalid formula ranges and mutable pins. The clearer targets are repeated intake, register reconstruction, rerouting and routine coordination, including Sciences receipts.

Recommend immutable complete input releases; early source/admissibility checks; focused independent checks at consequential milestones; one incremental claim register separating numerical fixes from physical qualifications; validated event types and batched receipts. Robotics retains progress. Compare context turnover by coherent work-piece before mandating a fresh seat per card; measure accepted completions and attributed costs.

Next ground thin-sheet/bond/core behavior, full-member compression and scatter, assembled barrier/desiccant performance, and retention/drying. MAINLINE047's regularized core remains unsourced; 056's 6.03 MPa target is a simulation, not a physical benchmark. The seven-day cavity margin is only 1.1155 kg; weather coverage is not availability. No scientific recomputation or simjob was performed.
numerical_scope: Synthesis of attributed reports; consult named check/review findings for numerical disposition
qualification: The common equations do not qualify the bond, core law, coatings or installed safety factor. Carry the exact conventions, not an interchangeable headline. [052 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:3a70e117fbb14e85), [CHECK053](unpublished-local-ref:599d3a276c2fcbce).
